title.zh: 配置由它怎样关系而定
title.en: A configuration is how it relates

statement.zh: 互模拟所联系的配置相同，相同的配置通过同样的检验；有意义的描述恰把相同者等同，框架相同之下确定时它承载规律；作为相等的确定性依赖于命名。
statement.en: Configurations related by a bisimulation are alike and pass the same tests; a description makes sense where it identifies exactly the alike ones, and carries a law where the frame is determined up to likeness; determinacy as equality depends on names.

laws.zh: 设 F 与 G 是配置类型 S 与 S′ 上、动作类型 A 与主张类型 C 相同的框架。关系 B 是它们之间的互模拟，指被联系的配置实现同样的主张，任一方的每一步都由另一方以同一动作到被联系配置的一步相配；s 与 s′ 相同，指有互模拟联系它们。
laws.en: Let F and G be frames on configurations S and S′ with the same moves A and claims C. A relation B is a bisimulation between them where related configurations realize the same claims and each step of either is matched by a step of the other by the same move into related configurations; s and s′ are alike where some bisimulation relates them.

laws.zh: 相等是互模拟，互模拟的逆是互模拟，两个互模拟可以复合；所以相同是自反、对称、传递的，作为关系陈述，因为商需要 Quot.sound。
laws.en: Equality is a bisimulation, the converse of a bisimulation is one, and two compose; so likeness is reflexive, symmetric and transitive, stated as a relation since a quotient needs Quot.sound.

laws.zh: 相同的配置实现同样的主张，以同一动作到相同配置的一步彼此相配，每个动作序列都到相同的配置，通过同样的检验：一个动作序列之后的一个主张。
laws.en: Alike configurations realize the same claims, match each other's steps by the same move into alike configurations and every course of moves into alike configurations, and pass the same tests, a course of moves followed by a claim.

laws.zh: 框架在 s 处相同之下确定，指 s 处同一动作的任何两个结果相同；确定的框架处处如此；相同之下的确定性沿相同传递，它成立时同一动作把相同的配置带到相同的配置。
laws.en: A frame is determined up to likeness at s where any two outcomes of one move at s are alike; a determined frame is so everywhere; determinacy up to likeness passes along likeness, and where it holds the same move takes alike configurations to alike ones.

laws.zh: Twins 中起点以一个动作有两个后继：它们相同，框架不确定，而它的起点与只有一个后继的框架的起点相同，后者确定，所以双胞胎在起点处相同之下确定。
laws.en: In Twins a start has two successors by one move: they are alike, the frame is not determined, and its start is alike to the start of a frame with one successor, which is determined, so the twins are determined up to likeness at the start.

laws.zh: 交换之律经“某个关系项立于某量”这些主张读，在每个关系项上相等是互模拟；水平相同，恰当它们在每个关系项上相等；这条律在每个水平处相同之下确定。
laws.en: Under the law of exchange read through the claims that a relatum stands at an amount, agreeing at every relatum is a bisimulation; standings are alike exactly where they agree at every relatum, and the law is determined up to likeness at every standing.

laws.zh: 配置的一个描述 π 有意义，指它恰把相同的配置等同；它有意义，恰当被它等同这一关系是互模拟且它等同每一对相同者；有意义的描述等同同样的配置。
laws.en: A description π of configurations makes sense where it identifies exactly the alike configurations; it does exactly where being identified by it is a bisimulation and it identifies every alike pair; descriptions that make sense identify the same configurations.

laws.zh: 框架处处相同之下确定时，有意义的描述承载规律（经 Becoming.Mechanism 的 carries_law_iff）；以配置自身命名有意义，恰当相同的配置是同一个，双胞胎的命名没有意义。
laws.en: Where the frame is determined up to likeness everywhere, a description that makes sense carries a law (through carries_law_iff of Becoming.Mechanism); naming the configurations makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one, and the twins' naming does not.

laws.zh: 对确定的律经一个映射读（主张是映射之值），配置相同，恰当它们经映射的未来相同，这时有意义的描述承载规律。
laws.en: For a determined law read through a map, the claims being the map's value, configurations are alike exactly where their futures through the map are the same, and there a description that makes sense carries a law.

laws.zh: 外围桥接中：RelationalDynamics 的 Deeper.Bisimulation 就是核心的没有主张的框架之间的互模拟，所以 static 与 toggle 中一方的每个配置都与另一方的每个配置相同。
laws.en: In the periphery bridge, Deeper.Bisimulation of RelationalDynamics is the core's bisimulation of frames with no claims, so in static and toggle every configuration of one is alike to every configuration of the other.

laws.zh: 外围桥接中：ExplanatoryBranching.Bisimulation 就是以模型的条件为主张的框架之间的互模拟，相同的配置通过每个分支检验，否定与合取在内（经 bisimulation_implies_same）。
laws.en: In the periphery bridge, ExplanatoryBranching.Bisimulation is the core's bisimulation of frames whose claims are a model's conditions, and alike configurations pass every branching test, negation and conjunction included (through bisimulation_implies_same).

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提：相同由互模拟刻画，不是假设，也不取商；Alike.tests、exchange_alike_iff、identifiesAlike_iff 与 identifiesAlike_id_iff 是双向的。
hypotheses.en: No premise: likeness is characterized by bisimulation, not assumed, and no quotient is taken; Alike.tests, exchange_alike_iff, identifiesAlike_iff and identifiesAlike_id_iff are two-way.

hypotheses.zh: 互模拟比较动作与主张类型相同的框架；检验是一个有限动作序列之后的一个主张；经同样检验推出相同所需的条件由 tests-fix-likeness-where-determined 给出。
hypotheses.en: Bisimulation compares frames with the same move and claim types; a test is a claim after a finite course of moves, and the conditions under which passing the same tests makes configurations alike are given by tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.

hypotheses.zh: 相同之下的确定性（DeterminedAt）是定义；第一部分以 Determined 陈述的定理以它重述，见 determinacy-up-to-likeness。
hypotheses.en: Determinacy up to likeness (DeterminedAt) is a definition; the Part I theorems stated with Determined are restated with it in determinacy-up-to-likeness.

hypotheses.zh: IdentifiesAlike.carries 要框架在每个配置处相同之下确定；有意义的描述是给出的，不推出它存在。
hypotheses.en: IdentifiesAlike.carries needs the frame determined up to likeness at every configuration; a description that makes sense is supplied, and that one exists is not derived.

hypotheses.zh: 见证的结论：Twins 的框架，以及经 exchangeFrame 读的交换之律。
hypotheses.en: For the witnesses: the frames of Twins, and the law of exchange read through exchangeFrame.

does_not_show.zh: 经同样检验的配置相同不在这里陈述；其条件见 tests-fix-likeness-where-determined。
does_not_show.en: That configurations passing the same tests are alike is not stated here; its conditions are in tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.

does_not_show.zh: 有意义的描述存在没有陈述：以“与哪些相同”描述每个配置，要函数外延性与命题外延性才有意义；按相同取商要 Quot.sound。
does_not_show.en: That a description making sense exists is not stated: describing each configuration by what it is alike to makes sense given function and propositional extensionality, and the quotient by likeness needs Quot.sound.

does_not_show.zh: 相同不取商，所以“相同的配置是同一个”不是这里的陈述。
does_not_show.en: Likeness takes no quotient, so “alike configurations are one and the same” is not stated here.

detail.zh: 作为相等的确定性依赖于命名：Twins 中两个后继在每个关系上相同，框架不确定，而它与一个确定的框架相同（Twins.not_determined、Twins.left_alike_right、Twins.alike_one）。
detail.en: Determinacy as equality depends on names: in Twins the two successors are alike in every relation, the frame is not determined, and it is alike to a determined frame (Twins.not_determined, Twins.left_alike_right, Twins.alike_one).

next_delta.en: Counting configurations up to likeness on finite frames where likeness is decided, joined to relata-counted-up-to-indiscernibility.

correspondence.zh: 按 Ren 的“yes, put it on the board and start”：从 World 一侧陈述“配置先于其间的关系”这一分割。它把外围的关系的同一（RelationalDynamics，2026-10-06；ExplanatoryBranching 的分支检验）带进核心。那里发现“状态不变”读的是载体的相等（unchanged_reads_carrier_identity）；作为相等的确定性也如此（Twins）。读法（AI 的；Ren 同意）：配置的名字，像关系项的名字（Becoming.Identity）一样，不承载任何东西，能查明的对相同的配置都一样；交换之律下水平在每个关系项上相等就是相同，所以零前提计划以逐点性质代替函数外延性的承诺（§1.2，b(5)）陈述的是水平的关系的同一，函数外延性只再加上相同的水平是同一个。有意义的描述在本模块的定义上，对有分支、带主张的框架重述分支“Current math core (fork)”对一个确定的律检查过的 IdentifiesAlike（其 Saying.lean，回答 Ren 关于框架与成对的问题）。
correspondence.en: Following Ren's “yes, put it on the board and start”: the split “configurations prior to their relation” stated from the world's side. It brings into the core the periphery's relational identity of configurations (RelationalDynamics, 6 October 2026; the branching tests of ExplanatoryBranching). There a step leaving the configuration unchanged was found to read the carrier's equality (unchanged_reads_carrier_identity); so does determinacy as equality (Twins). Readings (the AI's; Ren agreed): the names of configurations, like those of relata (Becoming.Identity), carry nothing, and what can be found out is the same for alike configurations; under the law of exchange, agreeing at every relatum is being alike, so the zero-premise plan's commitment to pointwise properties in place of function extensionality (§1.2, b(5)) states the relational identity of standings, function extensionality adding only that alike standings are one and the same. Descriptions that make sense restate on this module's definitions, for frames that branch and carry claims, the IdentifiesAlike checked for one determined law on the branch "Current math core (fork)" (its Saying.lean, answering Ren's questions on framing and pairs).

detail.zh: 复用 Determined：确定的框架处处相同之下确定（Determined.at）；双胞胎不确定而与确定的框架相同（Twins.alike_one）。
detail.en: Reuses Determined: a determined frame is determined up to likeness everywhere (Determined.at); the twins are not determined and are alike to a determined frame (Twins.alike_one).

input.zh: 相同之下的确定性与它的见证。
input.en: Determinacy up to likeness and its witness.

detail.zh: 复用同一模块的交换之律（exchange、exchange_agrees）：在每个关系项上相等是互模拟，这条律相同之下确定。
detail.en: Reuses the same module's law of exchange (exchange, exchange_agrees): agreeing at every relatum is a bisimulation, and the law is determined up to likeness.

output.zh: 交换之律；它固定一步之后的每个水平。
output.en: The law of exchange; it fixes each standing after a step.

detail.zh: 复用 carries_law_iff：框架处处相同之下确定时，有意义的描述相同者同去，所以承载规律（IdentifiesAlike.carries）。GoAlike 以投影上的相等定义相同者同去；DeterminedAt.goAlike 以互模拟的相同给出同一形式。
detail.en: Reuses carries_law_iff: where the frame is determined up to likeness everywhere, a description that makes sense goes alike and so carries a law (IdentifiesAlike.carries). GoAlike defines going alike through equality on a projection; DeterminedAt.goAlike gives the same form with likeness by bisimulation.

output.zh: 投影承载规律，恰当相同者同去。
output.en: A projection carries a law exactly where configurations alike under it go alike.

input.zh: 有意义的描述承载规律。
input.en: A description that makes sense carries a law.

conditions.zh: 框架在每个配置处相同之下确定。
conditions.en: The frame determined up to likeness at every configuration.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.orbit、Law.orbit_shift 与 Law.process：确定的律经映射读的框架，经映射的未来相同恰是相同。
detail.en: Reuses Law.orbit, Law.orbit_shift and Law.process: for a determined law read through a map, the same future through the map is exactly likeness.

output.zh: 确定的律的轨道及其作为过程。
output.en: The orbit of a determined law and the law as a process.

input.zh: 经映射的未来相同与相同的等价。
input.en: The equivalence of the same future through the map with likeness.

detail.zh: 复用 ExplanatoryBranching.Bisimulation、Same 与 bisimulation_implies_same：桥接证明它的互模拟就是核心的，相同的配置通过每个分支检验。反方向（同测推出互模拟）在外围由 same_iff_bisimilar 在像有限时经典地给出；核心在有限、已定的框架上构造性地给出（Becoming.Likeness 的 alike_iff_sameBranchingTests）；核心的分支检验一一对应于外围的检验（桥接的 sameBranchingTests_iff_same），所以有限、已定的模型上外围的同测即相同，不用经典推理（same_iff_alike_of_finiteDecided）。
detail.en: Reuses ExplanatoryBranching.Bisimulation, Same and bisimulation_implies_same: the bridge proves its bisimulation is the core's, and alike configurations pass every branching test. The converse (passing the same tests gives a bisimulation) is given classically in the periphery for image-finite models by same_iff_bisimilar, and constructively in the core on finite decided frames (alike_iff_sameBranchingTests of Becoming.Likeness); the core's branching tests correspond one to one to the periphery's (sameBranchingTests_iff_same in the bridge), so on finite decided models the periphery's same tests are likeness with no classical reasoning (same_iff_alike_of_finiteDecided).

output.zh: 分支检验与互模拟；互模拟推出同测。
output.en: Branching tests and bisimulation; bisimulation gives the same tests.

input.zh: 核心的相同通过外围的全部分支检验。
input.en: The core's likeness passing all of the periphery's branching tests.

detail.zh: 关系项的标签不承载任何东西，名字跨步的模式承载同一；这里配置的名字同样不承载任何东西：相同的配置能查明的都一样。
detail.en: Relata's labels carry nothing, and the pattern of names across steps carries identity; here configurations' names likewise carry nothing: what can be found out is the same for alike configurations.

detail.zh: 桥接模块：外围的接口是脊柱的实例；外围的两种互模拟在此成为核心的。
detail.en: The bridge module: the periphery's interfaces are instances of the spine; the periphery's two bisimulations become the core's there.

detail.zh: 检验固定相同的条件：线性检验要两个框架在相同之下确定，分支检验要两个框架有限、已定。
detail.en: The conditions under which tests fix likeness: both frames determined up to likeness for linear tests, both finite and decided for branching tests.

detail.zh: 第一部分以 Determined 陈述的定理在相同之下的重述，以及需要相等之处的见证。
detail.en: The Part I theorems stated with Determined restated up to likeness, with witnesses where equality is needed.
